cohort: 161 children with severe acute malnutrition (SAM) presenting to Lady Reading Hospital, Peshawar, Pakistan.
finding: The frequency of biochemical abnormalities in children with SAM were: hyponatremia (14%), hypokalemia (68%), hypochloremia (16%), hypoalbuminemia (7%), hypocalcemia (35%), hypoglycemia (15%), and anemia (98%).
gest_age: Not mentioned, although gestation was recorded
